# Cropper.js 1.6.2

MIT license; see LICENSE. Bundled locally for offline image selection, dragging, resizing and canvas crop export.

Upstream: https://github.com/fengyuanchen/cropperjs/tree/v1.6.2
Distribution: https://www.npmjs.com/package/cropperjs/v/1.6.2

The app loads cropper.min.js and cropper.min.css from this directory. It does not fetch a CDN at runtime. Crop OCR uses the existing configured Qwen API and requires connectivity to that API.
